about: Rules for shared/sync.py: each copies 'from' (a file, or every file below a folder; relative to shared/) to 'to' (relative to images/<name>/) in each listed image.
images: "*" = every images/<name>/ with a Dockerfile (new folders join on their own); otherwise an explicit list of folder names.

A file source with a 'to' ending in / lands in that folder under its own name. require: files each listed image must contain, matching a regular expression ({image} = the folder name, escaped); checked by every run.

Copies are byte-identical and committed, listed in shared/sync-manifest.json (written by sync.py: copies no rule produces any more are removed). After changing a source or a rule: python3 shared/sync.py; CI runs python3 shared/sync.py --check.
